questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] Which of the following is correct about first-degree burns?
A. It affects only the outer layer of the skin
B. It affects all layers of the skin and underlying tissues
C. It affects muscles
Answer: A. In contrast, second-degree burns involve both the outer layer (epidermis) and the underlying layer (dermis). Option B describes third-degree burns, which extend through all layers of the skin. Option C describes fourth-degree burns, which go even deeper.
questions.en: Which layer of the skin does a first-degree burn affect?
questions.de: Welche Hautschicht betrifft eine Verbrennung ersten Grades?

timeline.labelEn: Ambroise Paré is the first to describe different degrees of burns
timeline.labelDe: Ambroise Paré beschreibt als Erster verschiedene Grade von Verbrennungen

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] What was Earth’s supercontinent called?
A. Gondwana B. Laurasia C. Pangaea
Answer: C.
questions.en: What is the name of Earth's most recent supercontinent, which assembled about 335 million years ago and began breaking apart about 175 million years ago?
questions.de: Wie heißt der jüngste Superkontinent der Erde, der sich vor etwa 335 Millionen Jahren bildete und vor etwa 175 Millionen Jahren zu zerfallen begann?

timeline.labelEn: The supercontinent Pangaea exists, from its assembly to the start of its break-up
timeline.labelDe: Der Superkontinent Pangaea besteht, von seiner Entstehung bis zum Beginn seines Zerfalls

questions.notes: The card's 'Earth's supercontinent' is ambiguous (Earth had several; Gondwana was a supercontinent too), so the open question asks for the most recent one.
